mapper.select: SELECT uuid, current_worker_epoch, COALESCE(worker_lease_expires_at + INTERVAL '10 seconds' > clock_timestamp(), false) AS lease_valid FROM code_sessions WHERE organization_uuid = #{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{scope.CodeSessionUUID} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
WITH worker AS MATERIALIZED ( FOR KEY SHARE) SELECT uuid, current_worker_epoch, COALESCE(worker_lease_expires_at + INTERVAL '10 seconds' > clock_timestamp(), false) AS lease_valid FROM worker
WITH worker AS MATERIALIZED ( FOR NO KEY UPDATE) SELECT uuid, current_worker_epoch, COALESCE(worker_lease_expires_at + INTERVAL '10 seconds' > clock_timestamp(), false) AS lease_valid FROM worker

SELECT uuid, current_worker_epoch, COALESCE(worker_lease_expires_at + INTERVAL '10 seconds' > NOW(), false) AS lease_valid FROM code_sessions WHERE organization_uuid = #{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{scope.CodeSessionUUID} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dsh_transcripts WHERE AND dsh_session_id = #{dshSessionID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsh_transcripts (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, dsh_session_id, parent_dsh_session_id) VALUES (#{input.Scope.OrganizationUUID}, #{input.Scope.WorkspaceUUID}, #{input.Scope.CodeSessionUUID}, #{input.DSHSessionID}, #{input.ParentDSHSessionID}) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, dsh_session_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO dsh_transcript_records (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, transcript_uuid, record_offset, payload) VALUES
(#{input.Scope.OrganizationUUID}, #{input.Scope.WorkspaceUUID}, #{input.Scope.CodeSessionUUID}, #{input.TranscriptUUID}, #{event.Offset}, #{event.Payload,sensitive=true})
mapper.update: UPDATE dsh_transcripts SET next_offset = #{nextOffset}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE AND uuid = #{transcriptUUID}
